title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Lodging Originals with the Line for a Correction
content:
A lodgement is the handing-back of paper originals of a `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` set to the line at the origin office, in connection with a correction requested on a document already issued. It arises only on types that require the originals back when an issued document is corrected, and it concerns the originals of that document still in circulation.

## The lodging party

Only the shipper printed on the document can hand in its originals, and it does so during a contact in which it has them with it at the origin office. The desk accepts the lodgement from the documentation party that holds the record only where that party is itself the printed shipper: its registered company name and the shipper name printed on the document must be identical, character for character. Where they are not, the correction request remains pending for the shipper.

## The entry made

Each lodgement becomes a single entry in the documentation history, showing how many originals were handed in. It is free of charge. The document's figure for originals outstanding falls by the number lodged.

## Invoking `return_originals_for_correction_b9bd03b3`

This is a customer-side tool: the lodgement is the shipper's own act. The desk does not run it; the agent unlocks it for the customer with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, and the customer themselves then carries it out through `call_user_discoverable_tool`. One run records one lodgement of originals belonging to one set, dated on the day it is run, at the origin office.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bl_id` | Reference of the transport document whose originals are lodged, as the transport document lookup returns it for the document number the caller quotes | Identifier text |
| `bl_set_sequence` | The set of originals to which the lodged originals belong | Whole number with no decimals; 1 denotes the first set issued, 2 a replacement or switch set |
| `originals_count` | How many original documents are handed in by this run | Whole number, 1 or more, no decimals, counted in original documents |

### Return

On success the tool answers with one confirmation sentence that names the new documentation entry (an opaque reference beginning "bse_"), the transport document reference, the set number and the number of originals handed in at the origin office. The appearance of that sentence is the signal of success; the lodgement can then be seen in the documentation history, together with the lower number of originals outstanding on the document.

## Basis Q&A

**A forwarder holds the document record but the printed shipper is a different company. Can the forwarder lodge the originals?** No. The lodgement is taken from the record holder only where it is the printed shipper; otherwise the request stays pending for the shipper.

**Does a lodgement cost the customer anything?** No. The entry carries no charge.

**Hypothetical input and return.** For a document with reference "BL-EXAMPLE", set 1, lodging 3 originals, a successful run returns a sentence naming an entry such as "bse_…", the document "BL-EXAMPLE", set 1 and 3 originals handed in at the origin office.
